scope: Checked CPU uint32 reduceSum, with shared signed/unsigned reduction lowering and conformance harnesses.

semantics.types: CPU uint32 tensor input and exact uint32 scalar output; ranks zero through three qualified, including zero extents. No implicit conversions.
semantics.order: Existing row-major balanced-adjacent tree with unchanged odd tail; every addition zero-extends to uint64, checks against UINT32_MAX and narrows. Rank zero returns its one cell; empty returns zero.
semantics.overflow: Checked in all build modes. Both first-pair and later/root overflow fault at the reduceSum source location. Nonnegative unsigned terms cannot cancel an overflowing partial sum back into range.
semantics.reuse: Existing element-aware scratch/tree lowering and integerBinary unsigned addition. Signed and unsigned qualification share the CMake driver and typed native reference harness. Runtime, scheduler, task backend, continuation planner and checked ABI unchanged.
semantics.ownership: Borrowed offsets/strides honored, input unchanged, invocation scratch settled after success, arithmetic/shape/allocation failure or cooperative cancellation.
semantics.tasks: Existing scalar layouts carry full-range results through nested worker calls/cached awaits. Overflow becomes TaskError.Fault/Arithmetic; recovery reuses parent tensors and starts another group.
semantics.remaining: UInt32 matmul and GPU integer arithmetic remain rejected. No new scalar types, conversions, public foreign-memory ABI or distributed execution.

coverage: unsigned endpoints and signed/float32 precision boundaries
rank zero, odd tails and empty axes
large trees around 256/1024 boundaries and 32769 elements, including late overflow
negative dimensions and excessive byte counts
immutable inputs and balanced allocation settlement
nested/cached worker results and tensor siblings
Arithmetic recovery with parent data reuse
source 2:3 on uncaught synchronous/worker faults and zero live allocations
MLIR zero extension and unsigned bounds checks
typed IR unsigned policy and backend mismatched-element rejection
signed reference suite reused and retained
prior unsigned tensor/task admission checks updated while matmul/Metal gates retained

performance: Correctness and mechanism reuse milestone; no reduction speedup claim.
distributed_execution: Not implemented; agreed design-review gate retained.
